title: Scrub out most calls to context.Background(), use CommandContext() for subprocesses
body:
Following up on #29869, this does a lot of the same work in libpod, and then replaces several calls to exec.Command() with exec.CommandContext().  It's two commits, so if it makes things easier to review, I can split the later one into a follow-up PR.

I'm not 100% sure we want shutdown logic to be using the main context, because it could get canceled at the worst time.  At present, the main context doesn't get canceled, and I'm happy to let others decide if that should change, but it's something to consider if/when we do.
